items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: so he took me under his wing and trained me to be a disk jockey

ctx.x: But I had fun. I used to make a point of doing one arrangement, at least one arrangement every day, so we'd have fresh things to play -- and we built up quite a repertoire.

Also, it was during this period that Larry Grant, who used to do the remotes from Lai Yi Chai's, where we played, decided I had a nice sound for radio, so he took me under his wing and trained me to be a disk jockey. So for a while I was a disk jockey on KHON, which was the local equivalent of KKGO, only it was an AM station, and...
